triage_tips[1].quote: A process named by a random service launched from the Windows temp folder

what_it_is.quote: A process named by a random service launched from the Windows temp folder

esql.query: from * metadata _id, _index, _version | where ends_with(process.parent.executable.caseless, "\\services.exe") and process.executable.caseless like "*\\Windows\\Temp\\*"

kql.query:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where InitiatingProcessFolderPath endswith "\\services.exe" and FolderPath contains "\\Windows\\Temp\\"

title: Remote service created for execution
triage_tips: Rule lists no known false positives, so treat a hit as suspicious until shown otherwise.
Check the Image path under \Windows\Temp\ and whether its name looks random.
what_it_is: Windows process_creation detection: a process named by a random service launched from the Windows temp folder through services.exe.
why_it_flags: Fires when the parent image ends with \services.exe and the child image path contains \Windows\Temp\. Rated high; tagged execution, t1569.002.
